verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a first-party data-sharing feature that lets you share data with other clusters without exposing cluster credentials or sharing compute (docs-17). Its compute–storage separation over object storage (docs-9) makes sharing without copying plausible. However, the evidence only says 'other clusters' and never confirms sharing across separate accounts or organizations, or that shared data stays live. Missing for 10: explicit cross-account/cross-organization sharing, explicit zero-copy and live-update semantics, depth documentation on how sharing is set up and governed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
